decision: Proceed with licensed partial imagery plus explicitly generic neutral roof/ground material. No alternative currently has both verified exact-gap coverage and compatible reuse within the remaining archive budget.

options.name: NYU 2015 alternate 20 cm ECW mosaic
options.known_fact: Official survey documentation lists a 20 cm ECW mosaic under Other datasets / Camera parameters.
options.inference: misc_other.zip may contain the documented mosaic, but neither its ZIP membership nor extra coverage is verified.
options.bounded_probe: A 64 KiB suffix Range request returned HTTP 200 and Content-Length 366295340, not 206. Response closed with zero archive-body bytes read.
options.next_viability_gate: Obtain an authoritative archive file listing and mosaic extent/validity preview or an exact-gap crop. Do not spend 366 MB merely assuming the alternate mosaic fills the same clipped survey boundary.

options.name: NYU original 2015 georeferenced RGB photogrammetry
options.limitation: The source describes georeferenced, non-orthorectified frames. A small gap-specific subset would need verified footprints, camera parameters and rectification against appropriate geometry; no such exact subset was identified in the bounded investigation.

options.name: NYU original 2015 oblique photogrammetry
options.limitation: Oblique JPEGs are not a top-down registered ortho replacement. Exact coverage, calibration and reconstruction viability are unverified; consuming virtually the whole remaining budget is not justified.

options.name: Additional neighboring NYU 500 m orthophoto tiles
options.local_evidence: The four acquired TIFF/TFW pairs cover disjoint exact 500 m tiles and already cover every numeric coordinate in the 768 m core. The four white components are inside those tile extents. Additional grid-adjacent tiles have zero overlap with the core and cannot replace these interior pixels.

options.name: Tailte Eireann Dublin aerial imagery
options.known_fact: Official product documentation advertises 15 cm imagery for greater Dublin and directs buyers to purchase aerial imagery extracts.
options.rights: The open-data page licenses data actually released as open data; it is not evidence that purchased orthophotography is CC BY. Mapping/aerial products have separate copyright licence and reproduction-permit terms.
options.next_viability_gate: Confirm an exact core/gap extract and explicit offline game-texture derivative/redistribution permission or an orthophoto-specific open licence. No imagery export or purchase performed.

options.name: Smart Dublin Docklands 2018 textured 3D data
options.rights: Publisher states CC BY-NC 4.0. The national portal labels the record CC BY-NC-ND while its description says BY-NC. Neither establishes unrestricted commercial derivative reuse.
options.limitation: Textured Docklands 3D data is not a verified ortho covering these four centre-city gaps. No texture archive downloaded.

options.name: NYU/UCD 2007 Dublin imagery
options.known_fact: The NYU group lists 2007 forward/mapping imagery in ECW and SDIA formats.
options.limitation: DOI resolution reached a UCD record returning HTTP 404. Exact coverage, pixel spacing and current reuse terms were not verified; 2007 introduces additional temporal mismatch. No archive acquired.

public_catalog_search_limit: Two narrow metadata-only CKAN searches (orthophoto OR aerial imagery, at most 12 rows each) returned zero matches. This is a bounded search result, not proof that no compatible Irish orthophoto exists.
confidence_summary: The four large native components total 12,374,367 all-band-white 5 cm pixels. They are boundary-connected, geometrically clipped, include IR=255 and cross scene features. Only 23 other all-band-white core pixels remain as tiny possible saturation. Large white components are high-confidence source gaps, not white roofs; the publisher did not supply an explicit validity mask.
